data.source_title: Association of Functional Status and Discharge Destination for Patients Discharged from Inpatient Rehabilitation
data.locator: Abstract, national IRF dataset and results; discharge self-care and mobility scores associated with community destination.
data.source_setting: US Medicare Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities, national standardized functional assessment data.
data.source_n: 490,032 IRF patients in the first 12 months of national data collection.
data.quantity: Adjusted association between one-unit higher discharge function score and odds of community discharge
data.unit: odds ratio per one score unit; percent range
data.source_evidence_basis: The abstract reports that higher discharge self-care and mobility scores were associated with community rather than noncommunity destination, using national IRF assessment data. Functionally independent patients commonly went to a community setting.
data.limitations: Observational association from one historical year of Medicare IRF data; scores and discharge destinations reflect case mix, policy, payer, family support, and facility context. Association is not a causal effect or a placement probability for an individual.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Include admission/discharge function and placement destination as linked but separate state variables. Use the relation qualitatively or for external comparison, not as a local causal rule.
